audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers reads Skill/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Skill/Irelia/Irelia, but its own whys say the opposite on three rows: whys[1] 'At 2 he edges it', whys[3] 'you out-skirmish his Q-W drain in the 4-5 window', whys[6] 'He out-scales you past two items'. The packet chart agrees with the prose on all three.
audit.why: The page was telling a paying player Irelia owns level 2 in the chart and Sylas owns it one line below, and calling the 2-item window Irelia's while the late section says he out-scales her outright.
audit.corrected: Level 2 to Sylas, Levels 4-5 to Irelia, 2+ items to Sylas — proposed as matched full/content pairs, with phases[1].why and phases[6].why rewritten so the reasoning matches the new owner.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correct: level 2-3 E online, level 6 as the Hijack standoff, first item, and Sylas's late scaling. Added the real Hijack cooldown (80/55/30) against Irelia's R (125/105/85) to make the level-6 spike concrete — he gets his ult back before she does at every rank.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states the cooldown gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Irelia's passive (Ionian Fervor) gives 'armor/MR shred' in whys[5] and spikes[2].text. Riot's text: the passive grants stacking bonus attack speed, and bonus damage on hit at maximum stacks. There is no resistance shred.
audit.why: It invents a scaling source and tells the player extended trades get cheaper as they go, which is exactly the fight Kingslayer's heal wins.
audit.corrected: State the real passive (stacking attack speed, bonus on-hit at max stacks). Carried the missing-interaction anti-heal item into wants.you[1]: Kingslayer heals off champions and is on 12s at rank 1 falling to 6s at rank 5, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade. Also anchored the dash cooldowns — Abscond is 13s at rank 1, and its recast (Abduct) pulls Sylas TO you, so it is his engage, not an escape once he has committed it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d were generic filler pasted from the trade lines rather than describing the cooldown they title.
audit.why: The two entries that name Abscond / Abduct said nothing about it.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the 13s rank-1 cooldown and the recast's pull direction.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Sylas's Abscond / Abduct is down.
edits.after: At 2 he edges it — Chain Lash plus a Kingslayer heal beats your trades until your E stun lands at 3, so farm and give that window.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he pulls ahead: Kingslayer sustain and a Hijack that is only 30s at rank 3 beat your dive — close it out before then.

edits.before: Your first-item spike with full reset uptime and Ionian Fervor armor/MR shred lets you stick through his E dash and out-DPS the Kingslayer heal.
edits.after: Your first-item spike with full reset uptime and the passive at max stacks lets you stick through his E dash and out-DPS Kingslayer once anti-heal is up.

edits.before: Your first-item spike with stacked Ionian Fervor (on-hit + armor/MR shred) and full Bladesurge reset uptime lets you stick to him through his E dash and out-damage the W heal.
edits.after: Your first-item spike with the passive at max stacks — bonus attack speed and damage on hit — plus full Bladesurge reset uptime lets you stick through his 13s E dash and out-damage the W heal.

edits.before: His R (Hijack) is the whole matchup: if you cast Vanguard's Edge he steals it and walls YOU out, so hold R until his Hijack is on cooldown or he's too far to grab it.
edits.after: His R (Hijack) is the whole matchup: cast Vanguard's Edge and he steals it to wall YOU out — hold it until Hijack is spent, and note his 80s to your 125s at rank 1.

edits.before: Bait his W (Kingslayer) into the minions empty, then all-in while his only heal and damage spike is on cooldown
edits.after: Buy Executioner's Calling early — Kingslayer is back every 6s at rank 5, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade

edits.before: Sylas wastes Abscond / Abduct — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Abscond is 13s at rank 1 — once spent he cannot leave your stun.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The recast pulls him onto you — that is his engage, not your kill.

notes: Fabricated mechanic removed: Irelia's passive was described as 'armor/MR shred' in two places; Riot's text gives stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage at max stacks only. Level chart flipped on three rows (2, 4-5, 2+ items) as matched full/content pairs — the existing whys already argued for the corrected owners, so the page was self-contradicting rather than merely stale. Hijack cooldown (80/55/30) is materially shorter than Vanguard's Edge (125/105/85) at every rank, which is the real reason 'hold your R' works; that is now stated. Anti-heal from missingInteractions carried into wants.you[1]; Executioner's Calling was already in report[8], so the itemisation section needed no change.
